mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts increase and the unemployment rate declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weak supply environment that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% and a decline in the consumer price index signal a tightening monetary policy that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate rises above 2% and the consumer price index declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment growth rate signals a strong labor market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment growth is high (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales and a rise in the unemployment rate signal a weak demand environment that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when retail sales decline and the unemployment rate rises (t-test p > 0.05).
